structured_output.what_is_happening: A token called "Memetically-Engineered Product" ($m/ep) is one of at least 11 tokens with the same name launched within about an hour of each other. This one (9Broy…, not a pump.fun "…pump" address) was created directly on PumpSwap about 13 minutes before detection. Its liquidity pool is not locked, so the creator can withdraw it (RugCheck: 100% of LP unlocked, few LP providers). It shows $216k volume against a $31k market cap and +200% in the first hour. GeckoTerminal counts 2,036 unique buyers but only 58 unique sellers, and GMGN tags 40 wallets as bundlers holding about 32% of top trader supply, with 37 linked insider wallets. That looks more like manufactured buying than organic demand. The older pump.fun copy of the same name (6mEf…pump) has a higher market cap and more volume, and it is probably the one the search result means (roughly $78k market cap, +1652%). GeckoTerminal links it to an X post by @CookedSupermann. I could not verify that post.

narrative.description: The name riffs on 'memetic engineering', the idea of deliberately designing memes. The story seems to come from one X post (CookedSupermann status). I did not find a wider cultural event behind it.
narrative.why_spreading: Something (probably one tweet) set off a burst of copycat deploys. Attention is split across more than 10 tokens with the same name.

token_connection.why_this_token: None found. It is a non-pump.fun copy launched after the pump.fun version (6mEf…pump), which came first and has more volume and a higher market cap.
token_connection.competing_tokens: 6mEf…pump ($84k market cap, $319k h1 volume, earlier). 7mDU… ($317k volume). Plus about 8 dead copies with near-zero liquidity.

authenticity.evidence: 2,036 unique buyers against 58 unique sellers in the first 15 minutes. 40 bundler wallets and a 37-wallet insider trade network. Creator balance is 0 (creator_close). The LP is unlocked and was seeded by the deployer on PumpSwap.
authenticity.uncertainty: I did not see X posts directly. The buyer count may include real copy-traders who were routed to the wrong contract.

structural_risks: 100% of LP is unlocked and the creator can remove it
Bundlers hold about 32%, plus a 37-wallet insider network
Same-name copies, with the pump.fun version as the likely canonical one
The deployer holds 0 and has already closed their position

structured_output.counterargument: Heavy volume and 2,000+ buyers show real flow at a $31k market cap. If this copy picks up momentum from mixed-up buyers, it could double from a small base before anyone pulls the LP.
unknowns: Content of the CookedSupermann tweet and whether it points to this contract
Whether the LP owner will pull liquidity

source_coverage.notes: Time was limited. A contract search returned nothing. A name search returned only a pump.fun listing for the competing copy. The packet lists no website or socials.

structured_output.thesis: A copycat with an unlocked LP and a bundled, likely fake buyer base. It is not the canonical token. High rug risk and a low chance of running.
